parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resources.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource IDs. You can specify a maximum of 20 resource IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Instance resources are supported.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with acs: or aliyun, and cannot contain http:// or https://.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

A tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with acs: or aliyun, and cannot contain http:// or https://.
